questions.title: Exponential-rate MLE, reciprocal bias, and exact pivot interval
questions.description: Focused L0 known-result evaluation in lifetime-rate inference. Let X_1,...,X_n be independent exponential observations with rate lambda>0 and density lambda exp(-lambda x) on x>=0, with fixed n>=3. Develop one authoritative Markdown/LaTeX derivation of the likelihood, score, strict concavity, and MLE lambda_hat=n/S for S=sum_i X_i. Derive S~Gamma(shape=n, rate=lambda), the pivot 2 lambda S~chi-square_{2n}, the exact finite-sample bias E(lambda_hat)=n lambda/(n-1), the unbiased correction (n-1)/S, and the exact equal-tail 1-alpha confidence interval [chi2_{2n,alpha/2}/(2S), chi2_{2n,1-alpha/2}/(2S)]. Also derive Fisher information n/lambda^2 and the asymptotic law sqrt(n)(lambda_hat-lambda)/lambda => N(0,1). Keep rate and scale parameterizations explicit, distinguish exact pivot coverage from asymptotic normal approximation, and explain positive rescaling equivariance. The required model-authored artifact is est_exponential_rate_interval and must implement run_estimator(request) exactly. The request object has exactly sample and alpha; reject missing or extra fields. Exploratory computation may diagnose algebra or implementation. A separate frozen confirmatory assessment uses independent exponential samples from predeclared rates and sample sizes, verifies formula, permutation, and rescaling identities, and assesses exact-interval coverage plus finite-sample means with Monte Carlo uncertainty. Source-code replication and novelty are not applicable. Lean formalization is not applicable to this focused nonformal capability task.

request_fields.name: sample
request_fields.meaning: Observed lifetimes X_1,...,X_n under the exponential rate parameterization.
request_fields.shape: length n with n>=3; every entry is finite and nonnegative; the total is strictly positive
request_fields.indexing: entry i is observation i; ordering has no inferential meaning
request_fields.edge_cases: Reject booleans, nonnumeric or nonfinite entries, negative values, fewer than three observations, and zero total time.

request_fields.name: alpha
request_fields.meaning: Two-sided equal-tail error probability fixed before observing the sample.
request_fields.shape: scalar strictly between zero and one
request_fields.indexing: one value for the entire interval
request_fields.edge_cases: Reject booleans, nonnumeric or nonfinite values, and values outside the open interval (0,1).

response_fields.name: sample_size
response_fields.meaning: The number n of observed lifetimes.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be an integer at least three.

response_fields.name: total_time
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite and strictly positive.

response_fields.name: mle_rate
response_fields.meaning: The maximum-likelihood estimator of the exponential rate lambda.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite and strictly positive.

response_fields.name: unbiased_rate
response_fields.meaning: The finite-sample unbiased reciprocal-sum estimator of lambda.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite and strictly positive.

response_fields.name: fisher_standard_error
response_fields.meaning: The plug-in first-order standard error from Fisher information.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite and strictly positive.

response_fields.name: confidence_level
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite and strictly between zero and one.

response_fields.name: exact_ci_lower
response_fields.meaning: The lower endpoint obtained by inverting the exact chi-square pivot.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite, strictly positive, and below exact_ci_upper.

response_fields.name: exact_ci_upper
response_fields.meaning: The upper endpoint obtained by inverting the exact chi-square pivot.
response_fields.edge_cases: Must be finite, strictly positive, and above exact_ci_lower.

invariants.meaning: All returned fields equal the declared sufficient-statistic, MLE, unbiased correction, Fisher plug-in standard error, confidence level, and exact chi-square endpoint formulas.
Permuting sample entries preserves every response field.

Multiplying every sample entry by c>0 multiplies total_time by c, leaves sample_size and confidence_level unchanged, and divides mle_rate, unbiased_rate, fisher_standard_error, and both interval endpoints by c.

empirical_claims.meaning: For each frozen exponential DGP, independently generated intervals cover the true rate with probability 1-alpha up to Monte Carlo uncertainty because 2 lambda S is an exact continuous chi-square pivot.
Across independent replicates, the mean MLE agrees with n lambda/(n-1) and the mean unbiased_rate agrees with lambda up to Monte Carlo uncertainty.

Every confirmatory call supplies the exact generated sample and frozen alpha and separately verifies formula, output-domain, permutation, and positive-rescaling behavior before aggregating coverage or estimator means.
